headline: The autopilot stops bluffing
lede: LEMMINGS-LITE's attract demos no longer flash a BUILDER grant that lays no wood — the solver now certifies its own scripts against the replay world before anyone watches them.

notes.text: DOOR's t240 and LEDGE's t1667 phantom BUILDER commits are gone from the recorded scripts; SPIRE's 12-plank east-face road and MASSIF's 4-plank trench bridge lay exactly as before, and every board still delivers its quota.

Removal is demanded, not assumed: the stripped script must still win with no extra deaths, and on today's boards the stripped replays are bit-identical. lemcheck plants a live phantom and requires the validator to remove it — disabling the hygiene reddens 3 of 259 pins.

QA polish pass #3879 filed for LEMMINGS-LITE (sloped planks, walk cycles, splintering wood, music, vents/trampolines/teleports). The honest gap list now leads with the DOOR stamp-offset — the one real-feel planner fix left, scoped carefully because it re-times digests.
